notes: Run of 2026-11-25. Five Hoodline stories queued; three name San Francisco buildings. Published: Copper's expansion into the former Starbucks at 4094 18th Street (Hoodline's own reporting). Declined: the 329 Bryant tower story relays SF YIMBY, which carries the entry; the 55 Stockton sale story relays Commercial Observer, and The Registry's own account carries the entry. The holiday roundup names 101 California only as a light-festival venue; the Wendy's lawsuit names no address.

findings.description: Formal permits filed for a 42-story, 270-unit tower at 329 Bryant, keeping the historic building on the site. A relay of SF YIMBY's report.

citation.label: Hoodline, “South Beach Tower Plan Grows to 42 Stories, Adds 270 Units on Bryant Street,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: According to San Francisco YIMBY , the project has increased by six floors since its late-2025 preliminary application

publish.note: Declined: a relay of SF YIMBY's report of the same day, which carries the entry (news/items/sfyimby/2026-11-25.json, 2026-11-25-yb-0002). One event, one entry; cite the reporting, not the relay.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 329 BRYANT ST → parcel 3774006; sf-parcels has blklot 3774006 active, 329–329 BRYANT; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1916.

findings.description: The restaurant and bar at 4092 18th Street is expanding into the neighbouring storefront at 4094, vacant since the Castro Starbucks closed at the end of 2025; change-of-use and expansion permits issued in September, the combined space to grow from 825 to about 1,818 sq ft, opening planned for spring 2027.

extra.permits: change of use limited-restaurant to full-service, and expansion; issued September 2026

citation.label: Hoodline, “Castro Restaurant & Bar Copper Expanding into Former Starbucks Space,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: Castro restaurant and bar Copper (4092 18th Street) is expanding into the space previously occupied by Starbucks at 4094 18th Street.

publish.note: Hoodline's own reporting (photographed on site, permits cited). Headline names a business, no person. Owner and former owners named in the article are not recorded.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 4094 18TH ST → parcel 3582057; sf-parcels has blklot 3582057 active, 4092–4096 18TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc, built 1905. EAS puts 4092, 4094, 4096 18TH ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 4092.

findings.description: Thor Equities bought the eight-story office and retail building at 55 Stockton for $50.55 million. A relay of Commercial Observer's report.

extra.built_per_article: 1988, renovated 2023 (page carries the present building as 1989; not changed)

citation.label: Hoodline, “Thor Equities Drops $50.55M on Union Square Tower, Eyes Bigger SF Footprint,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: Commercial Observer was first to report that Thor Equities Group acquired the building this week

publish.note: Declined: relays Commercial Observer (not a registered feed). The Registry's own account of the sale, same day, carries the entry (news/items/the-registry/2026-11-25.json, 2026-11-25-rg-0003).

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 55 STOCKTON ST → parcel 0327002; sf-parcels has blklot 0327002 active, 55–59 STOCKTON; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1989. EAS puts 55, 59 STOCKTON ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 55.
